notes.title: Steam Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
As revealed in the Guerilla Collective showcase, Echo Generation: Midnight Edition is coming to Steam June 19th, 2024. Thank you for your patience, it’s been quite a journey and we appreciate your support! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364907/b8fe43fe941dadc68c1660074650dd7d05801eae.png

What's New?
In addition to the base game, Midnight Edition includes quality of life improvements, bug fixes and more:

 Fast travel
 Quest tracker (Journal)
 Combat updates - Balancing and new status effects
 New camera controls - Tilt and zoom
 12 new languages
 Controller support for Xbox and PlayStation
 Steam achievements


What's Next?
For now, don't forget to add the game to your wish list and follow us on socials:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072300/Echo_Generation_Midnight_Edition/ 

Discord: https://discord.gg/NZCaCaX27b 
Twitter / X: https://x.com/cococucumberco 
Press requests / content creators: info(at)cococucumber.co


Until next time,

- The Coco Crew

notes.title: Echo Generation - Steam Release TBA
notes.notes:
Hi friends,

Some of you may have noticed that we announced the launch date for Echo Generation on Xbox and Windows PC and are wondering if the game will be released on Steam. 

Although we are an Xbox exclusive on initial release, we plan to bring Echo Generation to Steam at a later date (to be announced). 

[previewyoutube=l_2CPTovBGY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











Play on Windows PC

If you would like to play the game on Windows PC, Echo Generation will be available on the Xbox App on October 21st, 2021. It will also launch on Xbox Game Pass and Game Pass for PC on the same date.


Echo Generation Store Page - Xbox / Windows



Play on Steam

If you would like to play on Steam, thanks for your patience. Don't forget to add Echo Generation to your wishlist to be notified when it launches on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072300/Echo_Generation/


Keep up with Echo Generation news and updates:

Follow on Twitter
Echo Generation - Join Discord


Thanks for your support!

- The Coco Crew
